rule: Higher-priority placement knowledge supersedes lower-priority knowledge. Component validation never proves assembly validity.

precedence.description: Exact exported JSON recipe, known feature recipe, or validated recipe signature for a feature/assembly.
No Man's Sky Builder add-on snap definitions / live plugin relational data for snap-covered joins.
Named validated assembly method with conformance criteria.
Verified part-map component mechanics: origin, bbox, default orientation, scale behavior.
Part-specific placement maps or orientation overrides.
Exception / do-not-use / negative knowledge. Exceptions override positive component data.
Allowed only when explicitly permitted by the method authority table and marked review-required.

hard_rules: Structural-critical contexts cannot use manual fallback unless the method authority table explicitly allows it.
If an ObjectID or method is outside the build snapshot, the build must be blocked until the snapshot is updated.
Exception entries such as CUBEWALL_SPACE and PIPE/BUBPIPE override ordinary component confidence.
